quote: We measure the supervision quality in competitive programming by programs' passing rates on unit test cases. Specifically, we aggregate the program's performance on test cases with two metrics. Test Case Average Accuracy computes the average fraction of test cases passed among all the test cases. Strict Accuracy computes the average fraction of programs that pass all test cases.
